This '''species''' was a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] that existed in [[the galaxy]].<ref name="Chapter 3" />

==Biology and appearance==
This bipedal [[humanoid]] [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] was distinguished by their [[Color|dark]] skin, curved horns that protruded from the sides of their heads, and a lack of visible [[ear]]s.<ref name="Chapter 3" />

==Species in the galaxy==
By [[9 ABY]],<ref name="Date">{{MandoDate|3}}</ref> a member of this species served as a [[bounty hunter]] for the [[Bounty Hunters' Guild|Guild]] on the [[planet]] [[Nevarro]], though they were defeated while attempting to take down the [[Mandalorian]] [[Din Djarin]].<ref name="Chapter 3" />

==Behind the scenes==
This species first appeared in the [[Chapter 3: The Sin|third episode]] of the [[2019]] television series, ''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian]],'' directed by [[Deborah Chow]].<ref name="Chapter 3" />
